summary.title: Summary
text: Research focused on Differential Privacy and parameter-efficient fine-tuning of LLMs, with papers on tabular data synthesis, memorization risks, and explainable governance of synthetic health data.

items.title: synth-pipeline
subtitle: Privacy-Preserving Tabular Data Synthesis Pipeline
bullets: Built a configurable pipeline for synthetic tabular data generation with LoRA-fine-tuned LLMs, with optional Differential Privacy (DP-SGD via Opacus) and schema-validated outputs.

Implemented an automated benchmark suite assessing statistical fidelity (TVD, correlation error), machine learning utility (TSTR), and privacy protection (distance to closest record, membership inference).

items.title: chesSLM
subtitle: Decoder-only Language Model Trained on Chess Games
bullets: Engineered a ~100M-parameter Transformer from scratch in PyTorch featuring Pre-LN blocks, Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE), and FlashAttention kernels.
Trained via a two-stage curriculum (mixed precision, gradient accumulation, cosine decay) and packaged as a standalone UCI chess engine rated ~1650 Elo.
